chapter: Fletcher Henderson, Ella Fitzgerald and the early 1940s
title: Back in New York: Don Redman at the Savoy and the Nemo Club group
summary: He played with Don Redman at the Savoy and led a small band with Don Byas at the Nemo Club, Elks Rendezvous and Kelly's Stables.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: at the Savoy for a while. And then Benny Carter and I got a group. It was Benny Carter's group but I had the book. First I had a band at the Nemo Club with me, Don Byas -- small band, like a John Kirby style band with Don Byas on tenor and I played clarinet. And Otis Johnson on trumpet, Pete Jacobs on drums, Clyde Harte on piano and Bass Hill on bass. We played at the Nemo Club and we played at the -- that was Bill Robinson's place. And we played also at the Elks Rendezvous at the Town. And then we also played at Kelly's Stables downtown.
